name: Lich's Ledger
summary: Lich's Ledger is an isometric action roguelite. The player controls a lich with no health bar: damage drains mana, and the same mana pool pays for every spell. Eighteen hand-placed minibosses each fight with the spells and gear they drop, so the player learns each spell by having it used against them and can then use it themselves. During each run, the Beast climbs up through the dungeon's five floors to hunt the player. The player places phylacteries through the dungeon and returns to one after dying, unless the Beast has destroyed it. The dungeon is inspired by the underground city of Derinkuyu, is built by hand and does not change between runs. Spells and items found in a run unlock permanently, and every run ends with a score.
